desc: write a property value to a device-tree
u: fdtput - write a property value to a device-tree
Write a property value to a device-tree. The command line arguments are joined together into a single value.

-h
Print this help.
-v
Verbose: display each value decoded from command line
-t <type>
Type of data
<type> s=string, i=int, u=unsigned, x=hex
Optional modifier prefix:
hh or b=byte, h=2 byte, l=4 byte (default)
